transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?
I'm here because I've been feeling persistently depressed, sad, and empty for a really long time. This constant low mood has been going on for about two years and five months now.
During these past two and a half years, have there been any periods lasting longer than two months where your mood felt completely back to normal?
No, not at all. I haven't had any breaks from this feeling that lasted more than a few days, let alone two months. It has just been a constant, heavy weight the entire time.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt the exact opposite—extremely energized, hyper, or on top of the world for several days in a row?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. My mood has consistently been on the lower, depressed side, and I've never felt hyper or on top of the world. It has just been a constant low for me.
Along with this low mood, have you lost interest or pleasure in almost all the activities you used to enjoy?
I haven't really noticed a loss of interest, to be honest. I'm not entirely sure if I've lost interest in my usual activities, it's just hard to tell.
How has your energy level or your sleep been during these past two years?

My sleep has been terrible for the last two and a half years; I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly, wake up too early, sometimes sleep way too much, and have bad nightmares. I always wake up feeling completely unrefreshed, and because of that, my energy levels have been extremely low.
How do you feel about yourself? Have you struggled with low self-esteem or feelings of hopelessness during this time?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't thought much about my self-esteem or hopelessness lately. It's just hard to say.
Have you had any trouble concentrating, focusing, or making decisions during this time?
I haven't really noticed any significant issues with my concentration or focus. Making decisions hasn't been a major problem for me either during this time.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight during this time, such as eating much less or much more than usual?
I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or my weight. My eating habits have stayed pretty much the same during this time.
Have you struggled with feelings of worthlessness or excessive, inappropriate guilt during this period of low mood?
No, I haven't really struggled with feelings of worthlessness or guilt. Those aren't things that have been on my mind during this time.
You mentioned having bad nightmares. Have you ever experienced or witnessed an extremely traumatic, scary, or life-threatening event in your past?
No, I have never experienced or witnessed any major traumatic or life-threatening events in my past. My life has been relatively quiet in that regard.
